h1: Arosa Lenzerheide ski resort, stays & events guide
heroText: Two resorts, one ski area: Arosa at the head of its own valley and Lenzerheide on the pass, joined since 2013 by the Urdenbahn cable car across the ridge between them. The operator's live panel counts 43 lifts, 225 kilometres of slopes, eight snowpark areas, twelve toboggan runs and 57 mountain restaurants. The page is placed on Lenzerheide, the side most visitors stay on.
stayOverview: Lenzerheide lies along the pass road with the Rothorn lifts above it; Arosa is at the end of its own railway in the next valley. The Urdenbahn links the two halves of the mountain between them.
hotelIntro: Book against high season. Lenzerheide is the road side, Arosa the railway side - the ski pass and the mountain are the same.
rentalCars: Lenzerheide is on the Julier pass road from Chur; Arosa is reached by its own railway from Chur.

season.unannounced: The operator publishes only the early-season period - weekend operation from 31 October to 22 November 2026 - and no dates for the winter season itself.
